title: SpanishHopeMultidomain Benchmark: Experimental Framework and Reproducibility Materials
description: Experimental framework and reproducibility materials for the SpanishHopeMultidomain benchmark. The repository provides fixed benchmark partitions, scripts for sparse-feature machine learning, supervised transformer-based models, and zero-shot instruction-tuned large language models, together with prediction outputs, multi-seed experiments, bootstrap confidence intervals, McNemar significance tests, model-agreement analysis, instance-difficulty analysis, and figure-generation utilities for the controlled evaluation of cross-domain Hope Speech detection in Spanish social media.
